# We Are Teachers

> > A comprehensive resource for K-12 educators covering teaching strategies, classroom management, career development, and educational technology.

We Are Teachers serves as a professional community and resource hub for teachers across all grade levels, offering practical advice on lesson planning, literacy instruction, classroom technology integration, parent communication, and career guidance. The site features teaching tools, free printables, professional development content, and relatable perspectives on the daily challenges and triumphs of education.

## Key Topics

- Teaching Strategies
- Classroom Management
- Literacy Instruction
- Text-Dependent Questions (TDQ)
- Parent Communication
- Elementary Education
- Classroom Technology
- Lesson Planning
- Teacher Career Development
- Standards Alignment
- Close Reading
- STEM Education
- Student Recognition
- Teacher Retirement & Benefits
- Multilingual Education

## Teaching Strategies & Instructional Methods

- [Sending Kids Back to the Text: Creating Strong TDQs](https://www.weareteachers.com/sending-kids-back-to-the-text-creating-strong-tdqs): Guide to creating text-dependent questions aligned with Common Core RL.6.4
- [5 Things You Learn If You Don't Share a First Language With Students](https://www.weareteachers.com/5-things-you-learn-when-you-dont-share-a-first-language-with-your-students): Lessons from teaching multilingual students and overcoming language barriers
- [How One Project Completely Changed the Way I Think About Teaching](https://www.weareteachers.com/how-one-project-completely-changed-the-way-i-think-about-teaching): First-year teacher reflection on differentiated Ancient Egypt scrapbook project
- [How One Inspiring Teacher Is Connecting With Students Through a Comb](https://www.weareteachers.com/inspiring-teacher-books-and-braids): Sara Medalen's Books & Braids literacy program at Sunnyside Elementary

## Teacher Career & Professional Development

- [Essential Advice for Every Student Teacher (Because We've Been There)](https://www.weareteachers.com/essential-advice-for-every-student-teacher): Practical mentorship advice for student teachers starting their careers
- [When I Retire, Can I Collect My Pension AND Social Security?](https://www.weareteachers.com/collect-pension-social-security): Teacher retirement guide explaining pension and Social Security WEP rules
- [3 Sticky Ethical Situations for Teachers (And How to Solve Them)](https://www.weareteachers.com/3-sticky-ethical-situations-for-teachers-and-how-to-solve-them-2): Solutions to ethical dilemmas in parent communication and classroom management
- [The Truth About Teachers and Network Marketing](https://www.weareteachers.com/teachers-network-marketing): Analysis of MLM side hustles like LuLaRoe for supplementing teacher income

## Classroom Technology & Digital Tools

- [6 Fun Ideas LEGO® MINDSTORMS® Education EV3](https://www.weareteachers.com/6-fun-ideas-lego-mindstorms-education-ev3): Creative LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 robotics project ideas for STEM classrooms
- [How to Strategize Your E-Rate Application](https://www.weareteachers.com/how-to-strategize-your-e-rate-application): E-rate federal funding strategies for school WiFi and bandwidth planning
- [3 Ways to Use Facebook Live in the Classroom](https://www.weareteachers.com/facebook-live-in-the-classroom): Practical classroom applications for Facebook Live streaming technology
- [7 Ways the LivingTree App Increases Parent Engagement](https://www.weareteachers.com/7-ways-the-livingtree-app-increases-parent-engagement): Review of LivingTree teacher-parent communication app features

## Lesson Plans & Free Teaching Resources

- [Learning About Seeds in Third Grade (With Free Printables!)](https://www.weareteachers.com/learning-about-seeds-in-third-grade-with-free-printables): Third-grade seed science lesson with free printables on plant biology
- [Free Printable: Spelling Word Search Worksheet](https://www.weareteachers.com/free-printable-of-the-week-spelling-word-search-template): Customizable spelling word search worksheet template for upper elementary

## Student Engagement & Recognition

- [31 Fun and Unique Ways to Recognize Your Students](https://www.weareteachers.com/fun-unique-ways-recognize-students): Creative yearbook superlatives and student recognition award ideas
- [Interactive Book Mural](https://www.weareteachers.com/interactive-book-mural-2): Daniel Warren school's Mo Willems interactive mural for book fair engagement
- [Is an Elementary School Graduation Over-the-Top?](https://www.weareteachers.com/elementary-school-graduation): Teacher perspective on fifth-grade graduation ceremony controversies

## Optional

- [10 Melissa McCarthy GIFs That Perfectly Sum Up a Teacher's Week](https://www.weareteachers.com/teacher-gifs-melissa-mccarthy): Humorous GIF collection capturing weekly teacher emotions with Melissa McCarthy
- [23 Totally Relatable Teacher Fails To Make You Laugh-Cry](https://www.weareteachers.com/totally-relatable-teacher-fails): Humorous collection of relatable classroom mishaps and teaching mistakes
- [QUIZ: What Amazing Thing is Going to Happen to Your Teaching Career?](https://www.weareteachers.com/teacher-quiz-amazing-thing-going-happen-teaching-career-2017): Interactive personality quiz predicting 2017 teaching career highlights
